Description: Line start-sequence step, 1..9 (SYS_ENC encoded). Drives machine status. Producing condition: 5-7.
Master ramped line speed - the actual speed every drive follows.
Selected line speed setpoint (from recipe, or slow-speed during start).
Ramped speed has reached the selected setpoint.
Customer footage counter. Operator-resettable from the HMI.
Any annunciated line fault is active.
Any annunciated line warning is active.

Status word from the oxidizer (INT, read by MSG). Bit 9 = Oxidizer Ready, a producing condition (HMI mirror p01_dint_to_hmi[0].9). Other bits: 0 combustion purge, 1 purge, 2 heat, 3 soak, 4 run, 5 bake, 6 fault, 7 shutdown, 13 oven purge, 14 process block open, 15 1/3 flow fresh air.
Running letoff roll diameter - how much substrate is left.
Line tension load cell at the splicer.
Letoff A yardage counter (scaled analog input).
Letoff B yardage counter (scaled analog input).
Letoff accumulator carriage position - the splice reservoir.
Letoff accumulator at full control position.
Tension stand 1 load cell - web tension entering the coater.
Tension stand 1 stretch (draw) applied to the web.
Tension stand 1 in Run mode (vs Jog/Thread).
Impreg metering roll surface speed - sets pickup / coat weight.
Metering gap, operator side (servo actual position).
Metering gap, drive side (servo actual position).
Averaged wet-web tension used by the metering roll PID.
Impreg enclosure solvent concentration, % of lower explosive limit.
Dip tank raised - the web is being impregnated. Producing condition.
Metering bar closed (physical input, SSS: Metering Bar Close): web through and gap applied. Producing condition.
Metering bar open (physical input, SSS: Metering Bar Open). Diagnostic companion to MeteringBarClosed: both on, or both off for long, is a travel or switch fault.
Zone 1 control thermocouple - the drying temperature of record.
Zone 1 solvent concentration, % of lower explosive limit.
Zone 1 temperature control is requesting heat. Producing condition.
Zone 2 solvent concentration, % of lower explosive limit.
Zone 2 temperature control is requesting heat. Producing condition.
Tension stand 2 load cell - the lead drive's web tension.
Tension stand 2 surface speed - the line's lead drive, measured from VFD feedback. The web speed of record for the producing test (>= 3 fpm).
Winder accumulator carriage position - the reservoir that covers a doff.
Web the accumulator carriage is releasing, added to winder speed.
Winder load cell - shared by both winder positions.
Winder tension error (setpoint minus load cell).
Winder A selected as the winding position. Also drops when winder A is stopped, so this is NOT a doff signal.
Winder B selected as the winding position. Also drops when winder B is stopped, so this is NOT a doff signal.
Turret index complete. Drops when an index starts and returns only when the move completes: one rising edge per completed doff. Drives the roll counter.
Turret positioning mode, 0 = original prox index and 1 = encoder. Roll counting is only valid at 0.
Winder A calculated roll diameter - build-up of the roll in progress.
Winder A yardage counter (scaled analog input).
Winder B yardage counter (scaled analog input).
Completed turret indexes since reset. Increments once per doff.
